Провода и деревья тактов

Вы узнаете

Как разветвление выбирает класс провода, как считается плотность трасс и сколько буферов нужно дереву тактов.

Провод тоже оценивается. est_wire_length разносит цепь по разветвлению: без провода для 0, локальный провод в 500 мкм для 1–4, средний в 2000 мкм для 5–16 и длинный в 5000 мкм дальше. est_congestion — это цепи на квадратный миллиметр, а кристалл без площади сообщает ноль. Один буфер такта обслуживает 16 приёмников: est_buffers_needed — один на 16 плюс один, но не меньше одного, а est_tree_levels равно 1, 2 или 3 по мере того, как приёмников становится больше 16 и 256. 100 приёмников требуют 7 буферов в 2 уровня.

Попробовать

Поставьте разветвление 4, потом 5 и следите за классом провода. Потом найдите число приёмников, при котором у дерева появляется третий уровень.

Открыть интерактивный урок →

The last three estimates are about wire. Set a net's fanout, the nets and die area, and the sinks of a clock, and read the wire class, the congestion and the clock buffers the compiler counts.

specs/compiler/hir_cost_models.t27

// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
; specs/compiler/hir_cost_models.t27 -- the HIR cost models' static estimates: comb and reg-to-reg
; delay, slack, fmax (TimingModel); dynamic and static power (PowerModel); wire length and congestion
; (RouteModel); clock-tree buffers and levels (CtsModel). Pure u32/i64 arithmetic, the numbers the
; reference compiler's analyze_module / estimate_module report from.
; --
; The rules live here. `t27c gen-rust` lowers this spec to bootstrap/gen/rust/compiler/hir_cost_models.rs,
; which bootstrap/src/compiler.rs mounts by #[path] and calls, as it does cse_hoist (#8991) and
; int_type_names (#9093). Never hand-edit the generated copy.
; --
; Provenance: the bodies are t27o's (specs/tools/t27o/rust_convert.t27) conversion of the hand Rust they
; replace -- compiler.rs's four impl blocks TimingModel, PowerModel, RouteModel, CtsModel, each fed alone
; through `tri t27o --check` (13 fns seen, 13 converted, 0 refused; the oracle passed, 0 vacuous). Three
; changes to the raw output, none in a body:
; - the TimingModel_ / PowerModel_ / RouteModel_ / CtsModel_ prefixes t27o gives an impl's members are
;   dropped: the hand fns and the wrappers that call this module keep the bare names, and the `Self::`
;   consts become module consts named as the impl named them (FR-001 of #9114);
; - the `pub const TimingModel = struct {};` unit-struct declarations t27o writes for `pub struct
;   TimingModel;` are dropped: nothing calls them, and compiler.rs keeps its own structs;
; - nothing else. Every return line is t27o's, verbatim.
; --
; The board-side twins of these estimates already live as old-style fns in specs/fpga/timing.t27,
; specs/fpga/power.t27, specs/fpga/router.t27 and specs/fpga/cts.t27 (consts as fns, if-chains, arrays
; with count fields). Their bodies differ token for token from t27o's here, so dupe_scan sees no copy, but
; the numbers are the same on purpose: one model, two homes, one for the compiler's own reports and one
; for the FPGA specs. A change to a number must change both.
; --
; The tests call each function by name. Their expected values are what the hand Rust returned on the lab
; (rustc -O -C overflow-checks=off, the fn text copied verbatim from compiler.rs): every match arm, both
; sides of every threshold, and the truncation boundaries -- not t27o's generic oracle samples, which do
; not reach every arm (the vacuous-sampling gap is #9102). Overflow inputs are left out: the hand fns run
; inside release t27c where u32 wraps silently, and a test that pinned a wrap would pin an accident.
; There is deliberately no consts test: `assert LUT_DELAY_PS == 100` folds at compile time and reports
; 0 runtime asserts, which is a vacuous pass (T730). Every const is pinned instead by the tests of the
; functions that read it -- all 12 are read by at least one of the 13, and those expected values are the
; hand Rust's own answers.
; ASCII only (L3)
; phi^2 + 1/phi^2 = 3 | TRINITY

module HirCostModels;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- timing

pub const LUT_DELAY_PS : u32 = 100;

pub const ROUTING_DELAY_PS : u32 = 300;

pub const SETUP_TIME_PS : u32 = 200;

/// TimingModel::est_comb_delay: LUT delays plus one routing hop, no setup.
pub fn est_comb_delay(num_luts: u32) -> u32 {
    return num_luts * LUT_DELAY_PS + ROUTING_DELAY_PS;
}

/// TimingModel::est_reg_to_reg_delay: the comb path plus the register's setup time.
pub fn est_reg_to_reg_delay(num_luts: u32) -> u32 {
    return num_luts * LUT_DELAY_PS + ROUTING_DELAY_PS + SETUP_TIME_PS;
}

/// TimingModel::slack: constraint minus delay, signed because a violation is negative.
pub fn slack(delay_ps: u32, constraint_ps: u32) -> i64 {
    return (constraint_ps as i64) - (delay_ps as i64);
}

/// TimingModel::fmax_from_delay: a nanosecond-second over the delay, in kHz; 0 delay asks no clock.
pub fn fmax_from_delay(delay_ps: u32) -> u32 {
    if (delay_ps == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return 1000000000 / delay_ps;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- power

pub const LUT_POWER_UW_PER_MHZ : u32 = 10;

pub const FF_POWER_UW_PER_MHZ : u32 = 5;

pub const BRAM_POWER_UW_PER_MHZ : u32 = 50;

pub const DSP_POWER_UW_PER_MHZ : u32 = 100;

pub const STATIC_BASE_MW : u32 = 50;

pub const STATIC_PER_RESOURCE_UW : u32 = 100;

/// PowerModel::est_lut_dynamic: uW per MHz times toggle, scaled to mW.
pub fn est_lut_dynamic(luts: u32, clock_mhz: u32, toggle_rate: u32) -> u32 {
    return luts * LUT_POWER_UW_PER_MHZ * clock_mhz * toggle_rate / 1000 / 100;
}

/// PowerModel::est_ff_dynamic: half a LUT's uW per MHz, the same scaling.
pub fn est_ff_dynamic(ffs: u32, clock_mhz: u32, toggle_rate: u32) -> u32 {
    return ffs * FF_POWER_UW_PER_MHZ * clock_mhz * toggle_rate / 1000 / 100;
}

/// PowerModel::est_bram_dynamic: block RAM has no toggle term, it burns per MHz.
pub fn est_bram_dynamic(brams: u32, clock_mhz: u32) -> u32 {
    return brams * BRAM_POWER_UW_PER_MHZ * clock_mhz / 1000;
}

/// PowerModel::est_dsp_dynamic: the hungriest block, per MHz.
pub fn est_dsp_dynamic(dsps: u32, clock_mhz: u32) -> u32 {
    return dsps * DSP_POWER_UW_PER_MHZ * clock_mhz / 1000;
}

/// PowerModel::est_static: the idle draw plus a uW term per resource, in mW.
pub fn est_static(total_resources: u32) -> u32 {
    return STATIC_BASE_MW + total_resources * STATIC_PER_RESOURCE_UW / 1000;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- route

pub const LOCAL_WIRE_UM : u32 = 500;

pub const MEDIUM_WIRE_UM : u32 = 2000;

pub const LONG_WIRE_UM : u32 = 5000;

/// RouteModel::est_wire_length: fanout picks the wire class -- none, local, medium, long.
pub fn est_wire_length(fanout: u32) -> u32 {
    if (fanout == 0) {
        return 0;
    } else if ((fanout >= 1 and fanout <= 4)) {
        return LOCAL_WIRE_UM;
    } else if ((fanout >= 5 and fanout <= 16)) {
        return MEDIUM_WIRE_UM;
    } else {
        return LONG_WIRE_UM;
    }
}

/// RouteModel::est_congestion: nets per mm2 of die; no die, no congestion to report.
pub fn est_congestion(nets: u32, die_area_mm2: u32) -> u32 {
    if (die_area_mm2 == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return nets / die_area_mm2;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- clock tree

/// CtsModel::est_buffers_needed: one buffer per 16 sinks, always at least one.
pub fn est_buffers_needed(num_sinks: u32) -> u32 {
    if (num_sinks <= 16) {
        return 1;
    } else {
        return num_sinks / 16 + 1;
    }
}

/// CtsModel::est_tree_levels: 16 sinks a level -- one, two, three.
pub fn est_tree_levels(num_sinks: u32) -> u32 {
    if (num_sinks <= 16) {
        return 1;
    } else if (num_sinks <= 256) {
        return 2;
    } else {
        return 3;
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- tests
; One test per function, its vectors the hand Rust's own answers (see the header). Boundaries: both
; sides of every threshold (4/5, 16/17, 256/257), the truncation edges both ways (999/1000,
; 999999999/1000000000/1000000001, 19/20, 31/32), zero, one, and the largest input that does not
; overflow the u32 arithmetic (42949669, 357913, 715827, 858993, 429496, 42949672, 4294967295 where
; safe).

test est_comb_delay_is_luts_plus_one_hop {
    assert est_comb_delay(0) == 300;
    assert est_comb_delay(1) == 400;
    assert est_comb_delay(2) == 500;
    assert est_comb_delay(3) == 600;
    assert est_comb_delay(10) == 1300;
    assert est_comb_delay(17) == 2000;
    assert est_comb_delay(42949669) == 4294967200;
}

test est_reg_to_reg_delay_adds_setup_time {
    assert est_reg_to_reg_delay(0) == 500;
    assert est_reg_to_reg_delay(1) == 600;
    assert est_reg_to_reg_delay(3) == 800;
    assert est_reg_to_reg_delay(10) == 1500;
    assert est_reg_to_reg_delay(42949667) == 4294967200;
}

test slack_is_constraint_minus_delay {
    assert slack(0, 0) == 0;
    assert slack(0, 1) == 1;
    assert slack(1, 0) == -1;
    assert slack(300, 500) == 200;
    assert slack(500, 1000) == 500;
    assert slack(1000, 500) == -500;
    assert slack(2000, 2000) == 0;
    assert slack(4294967295, 0) == -4294967295;
    assert slack(0, 4294967295) == 4294967295;
}

test fmax_from_delay_divides_a_second_of_picoseconds {
    assert fmax_from_delay(0) == 0;
    assert fmax_from_delay(1) == 1000000000;
    assert fmax_from_delay(2) == 500000000;
    assert fmax_from_delay(3) == 333333333;
    assert fmax_from_delay(4) == 250000000;
    assert fmax_from_delay(999) == 1001001;
    assert fmax_from_delay(1000) == 1000000;
    assert fmax_from_delay(2000) == 500000;
    assert fmax_from_delay(5000) == 200000;
    assert fmax_from_delay(999999999) == 1;
    assert fmax_from_delay(1000000000) == 1;
    assert fmax_from_delay(1000000001) == 0;
    assert fmax_from_delay(4294967295) == 0;
}

test est_lut_dynamic_scales_with_luts_clock_and_toggle {
    assert est_lut_dynamic(0, 0, 0) == 0;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(1, 0, 12) == 0;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(0, 100, 12) == 0;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(1, 100, 12) == 0;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(10, 100, 12) == 1;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(17, 100, 12) == 2;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(1000, 100, 12) == 120;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(999, 100, 12) == 119;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(100, 100, 100) == 100;
    assert est_lut_dynamic(357913, 100, 12) == 42949;
}

test est_ff_dynamic_costs_half_a_lut {
    assert est_ff_dynamic(0, 100, 12) == 0;
    assert est_ff_dynamic(1, 100, 12) == 0;
    assert est_ff_dynamic(1000, 100, 12) == 60;
    assert est_ff_dynamic(2000, 100, 12) == 120;
    assert est_ff_dynamic(20000, 100, 12) == 1200;
    assert est_ff_dynamic(100, 100, 100) == 50;
    assert est_ff_dynamic(2, 1000, 10) == 1;
    assert est_ff_dynamic(3, 1000, 10) == 1;
    assert est_ff_dynamic(715827, 100, 12) == 42949;
}

test est_bram_dynamic_has_no_toggle_term {
    assert est_bram_dynamic(0, 100) == 0;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(10, 100) == 50;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(1, 1000) == 50;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(1, 100) == 5;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(1, 20) == 1;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(1, 19) == 0;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(3, 7) == 1;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(2, 100) == 10;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(1000, 100) == 5000;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(20, 1) == 1;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(19, 1) == 0;
    assert est_bram_dynamic(858993, 100) == 4294965;
}

test est_dsp_dynamic_is_the_hungriest_block {
    assert est_dsp_dynamic(0, 100) == 0;
    assert est_dsp_dynamic(8, 100) == 80;
    assert est_dsp_dynamic(1, 10) == 1;
    assert est_dsp_dynamic(1, 9) == 0;
    assert est_dsp_dynamic(10, 0) == 0;
    assert est_dsp_dynamic(1, 100) == 10;
    assert est_dsp_dynamic(1000, 100) == 10000;
    assert est_dsp_dynamic(429496, 100) == 4294960;
}

test est_static_is_base_plus_one_mw_per_thousand_resources {
    assert est_static(0) == 50;
    assert est_static(1) == 50;
    assert est_static(9) == 50;
    assert est_static(10) == 51;
    assert est_static(11) == 51;
    assert est_static(19) == 51;
    assert est_static(20) == 52;
    assert est_static(1000) == 150;
    assert est_static(5000) == 550;
    assert est_static(42949672) == 4295017;
}

test est_wire_length_picks_the_wire_class {
    assert est_wire_length(0) == 0;
    assert est_wire_length(1) == 500;
    assert est_wire_length(2) == 500;
    assert est_wire_length(3) == 500;
    assert est_wire_length(4) == 500;
    assert est_wire_length(5) == 2000;
    assert est_wire_length(6) == 2000;
    assert est_wire_length(8) == 2000;
    assert est_wire_length(15) == 2000;
    assert est_wire_length(16) == 2000;
    assert est_wire_length(17) == 5000;
    assert est_wire_length(100) == 5000;
    assert est_wire_length(4294967295) == 5000;
}

test est_congestion_divides_nets_by_die_area {
    assert est_congestion(0, 10) == 0;
    assert est_congestion(1000, 10) == 100;
    assert est_congestion(999, 10) == 99;
    assert est_congestion(10, 3) == 3;
    assert est_congestion(9, 10) == 0;
    assert est_congestion(10, 1) == 10;
    assert est_congestion(1000, 0) == 0;
    assert est_congestion(0, 0) == 0;
    assert est_congestion(4294967295, 1) == 4294967295;
    assert est_congestion(4294967295, 7) == 613566756;
    assert est_congestion(100, 9) == 11;
}

test est_buffers_needed_is_one_per_sixteen_sinks {
    assert est_buffers_needed(0) == 1;
    assert est_buffers_needed(1) == 1;
    assert est_buffers_needed(15) == 1;
    assert est_buffers_needed(16) == 1;
    assert est_buffers_needed(17) == 2;
    assert est_buffers_needed(31) == 2;
    assert est_buffers_needed(32) == 3;
    assert est_buffers_needed(33) == 3;
    assert est_buffers_needed(100) == 7;
    assert est_buffers_needed(4294967280) == 268435456;
    assert est_buffers_needed(4294967281) == 268435456;
    assert est_buffers_needed(4294967295) == 268435456;
}

test est_tree_levels_grows_by_sixteen_squared {
    assert est_tree_levels(0) == 1;
    assert est_tree_levels(1) == 1;
    assert est_tree_levels(10) == 1;
    assert est_tree_levels(16) == 1;
    assert est_tree_levels(17) == 2;
    assert est_tree_levels(100) == 2;
    assert est_tree_levels(255) == 2;
    assert est_tree_levels(256) == 2;
    assert est_tree_levels(257) == 3;
    assert est_tree_levels(500) == 3;
    assert est_tree_levels(4294967295) == 3;
}
